aggregate_cpu_observation: Individual local snippet CPU figures are recorded where measured. There was no whole-process-tree aggregate CPU sensor or kernel CPU guard for preparation. Git and command discovery CPU were not separately measured.
enforcement_scope: Read-only finite queries and bindings. The WSL status commands used an eight-second subprocess timeout each with normal wait/exit. No synthetic or scientific launched worker. Before writes check exact encoded bundle sizes against the evidence ceiling; final sealed scope is tallied independently.
limitations: No tested worst-case scheduler or kill latency; no Windows supervisor runtime or Linux kernel qualification.
